title: Very Good AI Learning Platform
body: It’s a great platform wherein we can learn different languages like Python, Java and others. The best thing about it is that it is up to date using AI to explain the topics in a very simple way. Definitely recommend it.

title: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Powerful Coding App for iPhone
body: I've tried several coding apps, and Code IDE stands out. The editor is fast, supports many programming languages, and the AI tools make coding and debugging much easier on mobile.

title: Off to a strong start
body: I found this app not too long ago and have been pleasantly surprised by it. Being able to get AI help while building an app makes the whole process feel a lot less overwhelming. I've used it to test a few ideas, and it's saved me a lot of time searching for solutions or fixing small coding issues. It's not perfect, but it's already become one of those apps I keep coming back to. Looking forward to seeing how it improves over time.

title: Feedback on the Application
body: I came across this application and got really excited to see an Online IDE tool on the App store. Got curious about it so I did install it on my phone. To my surprise, it executes the code in many languages. Not only just the code but with the help of AI, you can actually create many things. With a few prompts we can create an application. I created a static facebook login page with just a one line prompt. This is amazing! The developer must have been very passionate about building this app. This app shows his dedication, consistency and commitment. A big shout out to the team.
